overview.headline: Federal tax inflation adjustments for 2026 filing season

keyPoints.point: Students learn the 2026 standard deduction increases to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly and to $16,100 for single filers.
keyPoints.quote: For tax year 2026, the standard deduction increases to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly.

keyPoints.point: Students learn the top tax rate remains 37% for single taxpayers with incomes greater than $640,600 in 2026.
keyPoints.quote: For tax year 2026, the top tax rate remains 37% for individual single taxpayers with incomes greater than $640,600

keyPoints.point: Students learn the estate basic exclusion rises to $15,000,000 for decedents in 2026, up from $13,990,000 in 2025.
keyPoints.quote: Estates of decedents who die during 2026 have a basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000, up from a total of $13,990,000

keyPoints.point: Students learn the 2026 earned income credit maximum is $8,231 for taxpayers with three qualifying children, up from $8,046 in 2025.
keyPoints.quote: The tax year 2026 maximum Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) amount is $8,231 for qualifying taxpayers who have three or more qualifying children,

keyTerms.gloss: dollar amount that reduces taxable income and varies by filing status with standard deduction levels
keyTerms.quote: For tax year 2026, the standard deduction increases to $32,200 for married couples filing jointly.

keyTerms.gloss: tax rate brackets that apply to income above thresholds for single taxpayers and joint filers
keyTerms.quote: Marginal Rates: For tax year 2026, the top tax rate remains 37% for individual single taxpayers with incomes greater than $640,600

keyTerms.gloss: exemption amount that provides an alternative minimum calculation and phases out for unmarried individuals
keyTerms.quote: Alternative Minimum Tax Exemption Amounts. For tax year 2026, the exemption amount for unmarried individuals is $90,100

keyTerms.gloss: credit exclusion that shelters decedent estates up to the basic exclusion amount for estates
keyTerms.quote: Estate Tax Credits. Estates of decedents who die during 2026 have a basic exclusion amount of $15,000,000, up from a total of $13,990,000

keyTerms.gloss: refundable credit for qualifying taxpayers with earned income and qualifying children
keyTerms.quote: The tax year 2026 maximum Earned Income Tax Credit (EITC) amount is $8,231 for qualifying taxpayers who have three or more qualifying children,
